repos_data.description: Open-source search database for full-text, vector, and hybrid search with real-time indexing and SQL.
One Postgres for your application data, full-text search, vector retrieval, and aggregations. Home of the pg_search extension.
The AI-native database built for LLM applications, providing incredibly fast hybrid search of dense vector, sparse vector, tensor (multi-vector), and full-text.

Search global patents across WIPO, EPO, USPTO, CNIPA, JPO, KIPO and other authorities, together with scientific literature from PubMed, arXiv, Nature, Science and other major sources using natural-language, semantic, keyword and structured search.

Embedded long-term memory database for AI agents & LLM apps. Six-layer cognitive architecture, knowledge graph, hybrid BM25 + vector search, sleep-time memory consolidation. One .meh file, zero infrastructure, pure Go.

Project-aware collection management based on Qdrant, including a Rust MCP, daemon and CLI: hybrid semantic, pattern and full-text (FTS5) search into single or cross-concerns collection. Dedicated collections for knowledge library, LLM behavioral rules, and an LLM scratchpad
